summary: Hines Global Income Trust filed an 8-K to provide an updated net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026, for each share class and corresponding OP Units. The transaction price is set equal to the NAV per share. The board's valuation committee oversees the process; Altus Group U.S. Inc. reviewed and concurred with the calculation. This is a routine monthly NAV disclosure, not a special situation event. The filing includes the valuation policy as an exhibit. There are no merger, tender offer, or restructuring terms; thus no risk-arb angle applies.
